weeklyDessert.name: shaman suryavamshi
weeklyDessert.description: A caramelised, smoky crust hides a velvety cream cheese centre. No flour, no fuss - just pure indulgence baked low and slow. Each slice is a labour of love.
weeklyDessert.pickupNote: Pick up cold. Best enjoyed within 24 hours.
